QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_56

question.text: Bhaskar Yield Fund has called-up capital INR 100 crore and hurdle rate 8% p.a. What is the Reference Hurdle NAV at end of Year 1?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook's Reference Hurdle illustration (Example 9.2), Reference Hurdle at end of Year 1 = Called-up capital at the beginning of the year x (1 + hurdle) = 100 x 1.08 = INR 108 crore. The Trap: Option B is principal only with no hurdle return. Option C subtracts the hurdle instead of adding it. Option D compounds for a second year. Note: The Reference Hurdle is the threshold NAV that must be exceeded before incentive fee can accrue for the year.
